title: DGX Spark - vLLM / LLM Performance
description: Throughput, latency percentiles, KV and prefix cache, speculative decoding and HTTP handlers for the distributed engine.

options.content:
**Every metric here describes the whole distributed engine.** Spark 2 runs
vLLM with `--headless --node-rank 1` and has no API server; the head's
scheduler drives both tensor-parallel ranks, so these counters are already
cluster-wide and are deliberately **not** split per node.

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate
panels.description: High means multi-turn chats are reusing prefill work.

panels.title: Spec-decode acceptance
panels.description: MTP speculative decoding: the share of drafted tokens the model accepted. Higher means the speculation is paying off.

panels.title: Spec-decode acceptance by position
panels.description: Acceptance falls with draft depth. This deployment runs num_speculative_tokens=1, so only position 0 exists.

panels.title: Prompt vs output token mix
panels.description: Stacked, so the split between prefill and decode work is visible.

panels.title: Time to first token  p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: Fine-grained buckets - these percentiles are meaningful.

panels.title: Inter-token latency (TPOT)
panels.description: The gap between streamed tokens - what 'feels' fast to a reader.

panels.title: End-to-end request latency
panels.description: Queue to last token. NOTE: this family's buckets start at 0.3 s, so percentiles are coarse for short requests.

panels.title: Queue and prefill time (means)
panels.description: Means, not percentiles, on purpose: these families share a coarse ladder whose first bucket is 0.3 s, and observed queue time is ~16 microseconds - every sample lands in bucket one, so a p95 would read 0.3 s and be meaningless.

panels.title: Engine iteration size
panels.description: How much work each forward pass carries - the batching picture.

panels.title: Finished requests by reason
panels.description: 'length' means the output cap was hit; 'stop' is a natural finish.

panels.title: HTTP latency by handler (p95)
panels.description: Which API route is slow, independent of the model itself.

panels.title: HTTP requests by status
panels.description: Anything but 2xx sustained is worth a look.

panels.title: Auxiliary model throughput
panels.description: Router, embeddings, reranker and OCR - all on Spark 1.
